props.name: label
props.description: Visible label for the expression field.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the expression after every edit, valid or not.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: Controlled IANA time zone the run times are computed in.

props.name: defaultTimeZone
props.description: Starting zone when uncontrolled. Defaults to the browser’s zone.

props.name: onTimeZoneChange
props.description: Called when the zone picker changes.

props.name: timeZones
props.description: Zones offered in the picker. The current zone is always included.

props.name: count
props.description: How many upcoming runs to list.

props.name: from
props.description: Count runs from this moment instead of now — for tests and fixed demos.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for the run times. Defaults to the browser’s.
